- **Buffalo Braves (1967‑1978)** – The franchise began in Buffalo before moving to San Diego and then Los Angeles.  
- **San Diego Clippers (1978‑1984)** – The team struggled financially and competitively.  
- **Los Angeles Clippers (1984‑present)** – The modern era, especially since the early 2000s, has seen the Clippers become a competitive NBA franchise.

**Current roster (2025‑26)** – As of the latest season, the Clippers feature players such as:

- **Paul George** (PF) – 5‑time All‑Star, franchise cornerstone.  
- **Julius Randle** (PF/C) – 3‑time All‑Star, versatile forward.  
- **Jalen Green** (SG) – 2024 NBA Rookie of the Year.  
- **Kirk Hinrich** (PG) – veteran guard.  
- **Julius Randle** (PF/C) – 3‑time All‑Star, versatile forward.
